greet.text: Corin Dray. I find wisps for people who pay. Don't look at me like that; the Listeners hear them for free, I just charge.

who.text: "Masks. Good coin, no questions. They want to know where the lights gather, and I tell them, and they go away. That's all." He doesn't look at you.

options.text: "So what? Greyfold's poor. Ysolde's lights don't buy bread."

choices.text: They're draining them under the fields. You're feeding it. Stop.
Here: a hundred gold. That's more than they'd pay you all year. Stop.

quits.text: He sits down on his doorstep, heavily. "Under the fields. I sent them there." A long breath. "No more. I'll tell Ysolde myself."

refuses.text: "Words are cheap. So am I, apparently." (You could pay him, or tell Listener Ysolde.)

paid.text: He weighs the purse, then you. "No more masks. You've got a strange idea of a bargain."
